title: Casting the restricted weight observation from inputs
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $S\subseteq J$. For any three sign-cube inputs, use the first input's coordinates outside $J$ as a fixed assignment and the second and third inputs' coordinates in $J$ as free assignments $y$ and $y'$. The rational observation formed from the two labels $f(y,z)$ and $f(y',z)$ and their respective lifted Fourier observations, when viewed as a real number, equals the product of the two corresponding real restricted Fourier coefficient observations.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
